en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 2.ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from ʿAlī ibn Shajarah, from his uncle Bashīr, from Abū Jaʿfar who said,

“The Prophet (ṣ) once passed by a dark-skinned lady picking up manure or camel dung from the ground, so the Muslims [who were there] said, ‘Make way for the Messenger of Allah!’ The lady said, ‘The path is wide enough [for him to pass].’ So the Messenger of Allah (ṣ) said to them, ‘Leave her alone, for she is insolent.’”
